popup.title: Pelican Valley Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find American alligators and black foxes.

popup.title: Grassrivers Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find Leonida panthers.

popup.title: Big Pine Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find black bears.

popup.title: Bobcat Key Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[Watson Bay]]
A hunting magazine said this is a good place to find Leonida bobcats.

popup.title: Gellhorn Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A hunting magazine marks this as a good spot for wild boars, wild white turkeys, Leonida panthers and black foxes. Recommended weapon: Shrewsbury SM-69 rifle.

popup.title: Grayson Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A good place to find black bears and wild boars.

popup.title: Moreau Hunting Spot
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A good place to find black bears and black foxes.

popup.title: Mutant American Crocodile
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Lives in the power plant cooling basin.

popup.title: Unique Bear (tranquilized)
popup.description:
Location: [[Hamlet]]
A unique bear with a rope around its neck and a tranq dart in its back roams this area. Hunt it and sell it.

popup.title: Albino Gators
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Good for deer, wild boar and albino gators (worth up to $3,650).

popup.title: Albino Alligator
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A spawn point of the albino alligator.

popup.title: Tiger in a Cage
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Shoot the caged tiger in the head and text Bret Vogel to pick it up.

popup.title: Unique Crocodile
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
A huge unique croc roams here: selling it to Bret Vogel gives an achievement (worth ~$30,000).
